summary: The SiteContacts module facilitates privacy management and contact details control for various roles including preceptors, instructors, DCInfos, and placements. It provides functionality to add, update, and delete contact privacy settings based on user interactions, validations, and conditions.
purpose: To manage contact privacy and withholding rules for site contacts in an educational or institutional setting, ensuring data protection based on interaction and system validation.

workflows.name: Contact Privacy Management
steps: User changes checkbox state or text input for withholding days.
Save privacy settings through functions (saveInstructorPrivacy, savePreceptorPrivacy, etc.).

workflows.name: Destination Management
steps: User interacts with list of included and not included destinations.
Adjust destination inclusion through Add/Remove operations.
Bind updated lists to the UI components.

validations: Ensure all numeric inputs for 'WithholdDays' are non-negative.
Check if the page and data inputs are valid before saving privacy settings.
Use Page.IsValid to determine whether the operation can proceed.
conditions: If the checkbox for always withhold is checked, 'WithholdDays' is set to -1.
Enable/Disable fields based on checkbox states and ScreenIsEditable flag.
Show/Hide elements based on ParentIDName and user interaction.
system_behavior: Auto-generates UI controls based on designer file
Persist user session cache and redirect after operations
Triggers privacy save functions based on UI events
